lead.zh: AI抛售加剧，标普跌3.7%、纳指年内转负；英伟达遭SEC调查再跌14%；俄军导弹袭击基辅三座大桥。
lead.en: The AI sell-off deepens: the S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and the Nasdaq turns negative for 2026; Nvidia drops 14% on an SEC probe; Russian missiles hit three Kyiv bridges.

title.en: Nvidia plunges 14% as SEC reportedly probes its accounting
title.zh: 传SEC调查英伟达会计问题，股价暴跌14%

summary.en: Nvidia fell 14% on Friday after Reuters reported SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues. The stock logged a seventh straight weekly loss, its longest since 2008, and is down 46% over that stretch.
summary.zh: 路透社报道美国SEC执法人员正审查英伟达潜在的会计问题，英伟达周五股价暴跌14%，连续第七周下跌，为2008年以来最长周跌势，期间累计下跌46%。

body.en:
According to [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/20/nvidias-7-week-losing-streak-is-longest-since-2008-financial-crisis.html), the seven-week slide has erased about $2.6 trillion in market value. Once the world's most valuable company, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet, and trades at roughly 8.4 times forward earnings, versus 29 times for AMD. Investors are increasingly worried about the company's future after co-founder Jensen Huang's exit.

[Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/5f374b32b07b/world/us-secs-nvidia-probe-is-examining-potential-accounting-issues-sources-say-2026-11-20/), citing sources, reported that the probe is looking at potential accounting issues and whether disclosures misled investors.
body.zh:
据CNBC，连续七周下跌已让英伟达市值蒸发约2.6万亿美元。这家曾经全球市值最高的公司如今排在苹果、微软和Alphabet之后，位列第四，远期市盈率约8.4倍，而AMD约为29倍。联合创始人黄仁勋离任后，投资者越来越担心公司前景。

路透社援引知情人士称，SEC的调查涉及潜在会计问题，以及公司披露是否误导了投资者。

title.en: OpenAI details defenses against adversarial distillation
title.zh: OpenAI公布对抗“恶意蒸馏”的防护措施

summary.en: OpenAI says layered safeguards on GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol cut successful extraction of protected reasoning from 54.0% to 0.2% in adaptive red-teaming. It warns distilled copies could strip out safety protections.
summary.zh: OpenAI称，GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol的多层防护在自适应红队测试中把受保护推理被成功提取的比例从54.0%降至0.2%。它警告，被蒸馏的模型可能失去原有安全防护。

body.en:
In a [post](https://openai.com/index/combatting-adversarial-distillation/) on Nov. 20, OpenAI said an actor can use a frontier model's outputs without authorization to train a similar model and deploy it without comparable safeguards, for example to help with cyberattacks the original would refuse.

Its approach combines adversarial testing, model training, input and output classifiers, and API-level controls that bind protected reasoning to its originating conversation, plus investigations into coordinated extraction campaigns. OpenAI says these safeguards now align more closely with those it uses for biology and cybersecurity.
body.zh:
OpenAI在11月20日的文章中说，有人可能未经授权用前沿模型的输出训练出能力相近的模型，并在缺少同等防护的情况下部署，例如协助原模型会拒绝的网络攻击。

其做法包括对抗测试、模型训练、输入输出分类器，以及把受保护推理绑定在原始对话中的API级控制，并调查有组织的提取行动。OpenAI称，这套防护现在与其在生物和网络安全领域的标准更加接近。

title.en: Russian missiles hit three Kyiv bridges after Putin vows revenge
title.zh: 普京誓言报复后，俄导弹袭击基辅三座大桥

summary.en: A massive Russian ballistic missile attack damaged the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Southern bridges over the Dnipro, hours after Putin promised revenge for strikes on the Kerch Bridge. Reuters says eight people were killed nationwide.
summary.zh: 普京誓言为克里米亚大桥遇袭报复数小时后，俄军大规模弹道导弹袭击损毁了基辅第聂伯河上的波迪尔-沃斯克列先斯基、达尔尼茨基和南桥。路透社称全国共8人遇难。

body.en:
Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said at least six people were killed and 15 injured in the Kyiv strikes, and two more were killed elsewhere as nine regions were hit overnight ([NBC News](https://www.nbcnews.com/world/ukraine/russia-strikes-kyiv-bridges-ukraine-crimea-putin-zelenskyy-apec-trump-rcna610372)). Mayor Vitali Klitschko asked residents not to drive into the city unless necessary.

The attacks also disrupted power and water. Per Kyiv city updates reported by [Kyiv1](https://www.kyiv1.com/en/yak-pracyuyut-mosty-kyeva-20-lystopada-onovlena-informaciya/), traffic later resumed on the Podilsko-Voskresenskyi and Darnytskyi bridges, while the Southern Bridge stayed open in one direction only, with weight limits.
body.zh:
据NBC新闻，乌克兰总理科列茨基称，基辅遇袭造成至少6人死亡、15人受伤；当晚全国9个州遭袭，另有2人在其他地区遇难。基辅市长克利钦科呼吁市民非必要不要驾车进城。

袭击还造成停电停水。据基辅市政信息，波迪尔-沃斯克列先斯基桥和达尔尼茨基桥随后恢复通行，南桥仅单向开放并限重。

title.en: Trump says Iran won't offer an 'acceptable' deal; Tehran says it wants diplomacy
title.zh: 特朗普称伊朗不愿达成“可接受”协议，伊方称仍寻求外交解决

summary.en: US-Iran talks remain stalled: Trump says Tehran wants a deal but not on terms he accepts, while Foreign Minister Araqchi says Iran still seeks diplomacy to end the war. The US blockade and Hormuz control remain central disputes.
summary.zh: 美伊谈判仍陷僵局：特朗普称德黑兰想要协议但条件他不能接受，伊朗外长阿拉格齐则称伊朗仍希望通过外交结束战争。美国海上封锁和霍尔木兹海峡控制权仍是核心分歧。

title.en: S&P 500 sinks 3.7% and Nasdaq turns negative for 2026 in AI rout
title.zh: AI股遭抛售，标普500跌3.7%，纳指年内转跌

summary.en: On Friday the S&P 500 fell 3.70% to 6,910.39, the Nasdaq dropped 5.28% to 22,617.73 and the Dow lost 1.93% to 48,147.33. The S&P had its worst week in more than 18 months.
summary.zh: 周五标普500指数下跌3.70%至6910.39点，纳斯达克综合指数跌5.28%至22617.73点，道指跌1.93%至48147.33点。标普录得18个多月来最差单周表现。

body.en: [AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-c10b797a17c2acf37924d834efebe135) said a bruising sell-off in artificial intelligence stocks dragged the S&P 500 to its worst weekly loss in more than 18 months and pushed the Nasdaq into the red for the year. The Dow fell 949.73 points ([Xinhua](https://english.news.cn/20261121/ceb60b5e161b462a9aa02301c75544ea/c.html)).
body.zh: 美联社称，AI股的猛烈抛售令标普500录得18个多月来最大单周跌幅，纳指年内由涨转跌。新华社报道，道指下跌949.73点。

title.en: Anthropic closes day two down 8.5% at $88.91
title.zh: Anthropic上市第二日收跌8.5%，报88.91美元

summary.en: Anthropic shares closed at $88.91 on Friday, down 8.5% from Thursday's close and still above the $83 IPO price, as the broad AI sell-off hit the market's newest giant.
summary.zh: Anthropic周五收于88.91美元，较周四收盘下跌8.5%，仍高于83美元发行价。AI板块整体遭抛售，这家新上市巨头也未能幸免。

title.en: Reuters: Beijing to bar young red-chip firms from listing offshore
title.zh: 路透：中国将不批准新设红筹企业境外上市

summary.en: China's securities regulator has told law firms that red-chip companies set up after the 2023 offshore listing rules must re-domicile in China before listing abroad, sources say, a move that could dent Hong Kong's IPO market.
summary.zh: 知情人士称，中国证监会已告知律所，2023年境外上市新规出台后设立的红筹企业须先将注册地迁回境内才能境外上市，此举可能打击香港IPO市场。

body.en: Red-chip companies are registered abroad, mainly in tax havens, but control businesses in China through equity or contractual arrangements. The structure is popular with Chinese tech startups seeking capital in Hong Kong or New York. The guidance was confidential and is being reported for the first time ([Reuters via Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/exclusivebeijing-to-bar-young-redchip-firms-from-listing-outside-mainland-china-sources-say-5040979)).
body.zh: 红筹企业注册在境外（主要是避税地），但通过股权或协议控制中国境内业务，这一架构深受希望在香港或纽约融资的中国科技初创公司青睐。路透称这一监管指导属于保密内容，系首次被报道。

title.en: Bessent: Trump and Xi agreed humans must stay in military AI decisions
title.zh: 贝森特：特朗普与习近平同意军事AI决策须有人参与

summary.en: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC that Trump and Xi agreed humans should always be involved in major military decisions using AI. Separately, Trump said only older chips should be sold to China.
summary.zh: 美国财长贝森特对CNBC表示，特朗普与习近平同意，涉及AI的重大军事决策必须始终有人参与。另据路透，特朗普表示只应向中国出售较旧的芯片。

body.en: Bessent called the agreement one of the major achievements of Trump's Asia trip and said it would not be affected by US-China competition for AI supremacy ([Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/trump-xi-agreed-that-military-ai-decisions-should-involve-humans-bessent-says-5042288)). Trump did not define a technical cutoff for older chips ([Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/trump-says-only-older-chips-should-be-sold-to-china-5042411)).
body.zh: 贝森特称这是特朗普亚洲之行的主要成果之一，并表示该共识不受中美AI竞争影响。特朗普未说明“较旧芯片”的具体技术界限。

title.zh: 五部门发布《海洋产业投融资指导目录（2026版）》
title.en: Five agencies issue a 2026 investment and financing catalog for ocean industries

summary.zh: 自然资源部、国家发展改革委、人民银行、金融监管总局、证监会11月20日联合发布目录，共11大类、42小类、185条，以智能化、绿色化、融合化为三大导向。
summary.en: Five agencies including the Ministry of Natural Resources and the PBOC issued a catalog on Nov. 20 with 11 categories, 42 subcategories and 185 items, steering capital toward smart, green and integrated ocean industries.

body.zh: 据《证券日报》，目录鼓励研发智能船舶、智能海洋工程装备，发展海上风电、海洋能，并培育“海上风电+海洋牧场”、低空海洋观光等新业态。相关部门将细化政府补贴、金融支持、海域使用等配套政策。
body.en: Per Securities Daily, the catalog encourages smart ships and offshore engineering equipment, offshore wind and ocean energy, and new models such as offshore wind combined with marine ranching. Agencies will refine supporting policies on subsidies, financing and sea-area use.

sources.name: 中国经济网 / 证券日报

title.en: Trump threatens 'tremendous tax' on US firms building data centers abroad
title.zh: 特朗普威胁对在海外建数据中心的美企征“巨额税”

summary.en: At a White House press conference on Friday, Trump said US companies would be stopped from building AI data centers in other countries and would face a 'tremendous tax' if they did. He gave no details and said his own staff had not yet heard the plan.
summary.zh: 特朗普周五在白宫记者会上表示，将阻止美国企业在海外建设AI数据中心，执意建设的将被征收“巨额税”。他未透露细节，并称连自己的幕僚此前都还不知道这一计划。

body.en:
According to [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/20/trump-data-centers-ai-companies-tax.html), Trump said companies "can, but we're going to put a tremendous tax on them," adding: "I haven't even said that to my people. But I'm telling them now they're here."

Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle already operate data centers overseas, often to serve nearby clients or meet local rules. At home, a CNBC survey found 64% of registered voters oppose an AI data center within 10 miles of their home. [AP](https://apnews.com/article/trump-artificial-intelligence-data-centers-f1ac03b73d13445400eeed8631d9d879) noted the plan comes as data centers face growing local backlash in the US.
body.zh:
据CNBC报道，特朗普说企业“可以去建，但我们会对它们征收巨额税”，还说：“我甚至还没跟我的人说过，现在他们在场，我就告诉他们。”

Alphabet、亚马逊、微软、Meta和甲骨文都已在海外运营数据中心，往往是为了就近服务客户或满足当地监管要求。在美国国内，CNBC调查显示64%的登记选民反对在住所10英里内建AI数据中心。美联社指出，这一表态正值数据中心在美国各地遭遇越来越多的反对。

title.zh: 华为新子品牌星芒OSTA首款手机O1 Pro发布，5499元起
title.en: Huawei's new OSTA brand launches its first phone, the O1 Pro, from 5,499 yuan

summary.zh: 华为11月20日推出新子品牌星芒OSTA，首款机型O1 Pro号称“首款为AI而生的鸿蒙手机”，搭载麒麟9030S、7000mAh电池，首发HarmonyOS 7 AI先锋版，起售价5499元。
summary.en: Huawei unveiled its new sub-brand OSTA on Nov. 20. Its first model, the O1 Pro, billed as the first HarmonyOS phone built for AI, uses a Kirin 9030S chip and a 7,000mAh battery, debuts HarmonyOS 7 AI Pioneer Edition, and starts at 5,499 yuan.

body.zh:
据IT之家，O1 Pro采用6.39英寸1.5K直屏。品牌总经理刘赫表示，Mate系列旗舰不会通过OTA获得星芒独占的“小星芒”、AI屏等功能。京东与华为星芒签署战略合作，目标三年内在京东实现全品类700亿元销售额。

同场发布会上，鸿蒙智行享界V8 MPV上市，售价31.98万至42.98万元；余承东称享界V8已开启全国首个120km/h L3自动驾驶跨城高速路测。
body.en:
According to IT Home, the O1 Pro has a 6.39-inch 1.5K flat screen. Brand head Liu He said Huawei's Mate flagships will not get OSTA-exclusive features such as the AI screen by OTA update. JD.com signed a strategic deal with OSTA targeting 70 billion yuan in sales on its platform over three years.

At the same event, Huawei's HIMA alliance launched the Xiangjie V8 MPV at 319,800 to 429,800 yuan; Richard Yu said it has begun China's first 120 km/h cross-city L3 autonomous highway road test.

title.en: UK and EU strike deals on food checks, carbon trading and youth mobility
title.zh: 英欧峰会达成食品检查、碳交易和青年流动三项协议

summary.en: At a Nov. 20 summit, UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, Ursula von der Leyen and António Costa concluded talks on a common food-safety area from March 2028, linked emissions trading from 2028, and a youth scheme for up to 100,000 people a year on each side.
summary.zh: 11月20日英欧峰会上，英国首相伯纳姆与冯德莱恩、科斯塔完成谈判：2028年3月起建立共同卫生与植物检疫区，2028年起连接双方碳排放交易体系，并设立每方每年最多10万名青年参与的交流计划。

body.en:
According to the [UK government explainer](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ukeu-summit-2026-key-documents/uk-eu-summit-2026-explainer-html), UK agrifood exports to the EU have fallen 32.5% since 2019. The sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) agreement removes export health certificates (saving up to £200 each), phytosanitary certificates and most border checks, and will apply from 1 March 2028 subject to both sides' procedures.

The [joint statement](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/ukeu-summit-2026-key-documents/uk-eu-summit-2026-joint-statement-html) also links the two emissions trading systems, targeted to operate from 1 January 2028, and sets up a Youth Experience Scheme letting young people work, study, volunteer or travel for up to three years.
body.zh:
据英国政府发布的说明，2019年以来英国对欧盟农产品和食品出口下降了32.5%。卫生与植物检疫（SPS）协议将取消出口卫生证书（每份最多节省200英镑）、植物检疫证书和大部分边境检查，在双方完成程序后于2028年3月1日起实施。

联合声明还宣布连接双方碳排放交易体系，目标2028年1月1日起运行；并设立“青年体验计划”，允许青年在对方境内工作、学习、志愿服务或旅行最长三年。

title.en: Zelensky calls Putin a 'killer' after Trump calls him a friend
title.zh: 特朗普称普京是朋友，泽连斯基：对我们来说他是杀人犯

summary.en: Speaking to CNN, Zelensky said Putin is 'an enemy' and 'a killer' to Ukrainians, warning that friendly words mean he 'doesn't feel enough pressure'. Trump had doubled down on calling Putin a friend, saying Putin would 'love to end the war'.
summary.zh: 泽连斯基接受CNN采访时说，对乌克兰人来说普京是“敌人”和“杀人犯”，并警告友好言辞会让普京“感受不到足够压力”。此前特朗普坚持称普京是朋友，并说普京“很想结束战争”。

body.en:
According to the [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cxnv4zvmdy0jo), Russian strikes on Zelensky's hometown of Kryvyi Rih overnight killed two people, including a boy, and injured 52. On Friday, at least nine were killed as 110 missiles and more than 400 drones hit bridges in Kyiv and railway stations in western Ukraine, which Zelensky called the biggest attack this year.

Poland said a Russian cruise missile was among three objects that violated its airspace early Friday, landing in a rural area about 50 km from the Ukrainian border.
body.zh:
据BBC，俄军夜间袭击泽连斯基家乡克里维里赫，造成两人死亡（含一名男孩）、52人受伤。周五，俄军以110枚导弹和400多架无人机袭击基辅桥梁和乌西部火车站，至少九人死亡，泽连斯基称这是今年规模最大的一次袭击。

波兰表示，周五凌晨有三个物体侵入其领空，其中包括一枚俄罗斯巡航导弹，落在距乌克兰边境约50公里的农村地区。

title.zh: DeepSeek千亿级融资落地，梁文锋仍持股约67%
title.en: DeepSeek closes 100-billion-yuan round; Liang Wenfeng keeps about 67%

summary.zh: 工商信息显示，DeepSeek运营主体完成变更，新增持股平台杭州程砚。据证券时报，本轮募资1000亿至1055亿元，投后估值约6155亿元，腾讯与宁德时代并列第一大出资方。
summary.en: Business records show DeepSeek's operating company added a new holding platform as a shareholder. Securities Times reports the round raised 100-105.5 billion yuan at a post-money valuation of about 615.5 billion yuan, with Tencent and CATL tied as the largest investors.

body.zh:
据IT之家（经新浪科技转载），杭州深度求索注册资本增加约21.1%。叠加2026年6月首轮约510亿元融资，两轮累计吸纳资金超过1500亿元。

31家外部出资方通过杭州程砚入股，腾讯与宁德时代体系各占9.5653%，中移投资、中信证券投资各7.6522%，另有中国电信、美团龙珠、小红书、vivo、美的、吉利等。梁文锋持有执行事务合伙人杭州程策99%股权，直接及间接合计持股约67.42%，控制权不变。
body.en:
According to IT Home (via Sina Tech), DeepSeek's registered capital rose about 21.1%. Together with a first round of about 51 billion yuan in June 2026, the two rounds total more than 150 billion yuan.

Thirty-one outside investors came in through the Hangzhou Chengyan platform: Tencent and CATL entities hold 9.5653% each, China Mobile's investment arm and CITIC Securities Investment 7.6522% each, plus China Telecom, Meituan Dragonball, Xiaohongshu, vivo, Midea and Geely. Liang Wenfeng owns 99% of the general partner and about 67.42% of DeepSeek directly and indirectly, so control is unchanged.

title.en: SK Hynix to become Kioxia's largest shareholder via bond conversion
title.zh: SK海力士将通过债转股成为铠侠最大股东

summary.en: SK Hynix will convert bonds of a Bain-led investment vehicle into shares in December, giving it an indirect stake of about 14.1% in Japanese rival Kioxia. It says it has no plans to buy more and its role in management will stay limited.
summary.zh: SK海力士将于12月把贝恩主导的投资载体债券转换为股份，间接持有日本对手铠侠约14.1%股权，成为最大股东。公司表示暂无增持计划，参与铠侠经营的程度仍将有限。

body.en: According to [Reuters via CNA](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/sk-hynix-become-top-shareholder-in-rival-kioxia-after-bond-conversion-6569061), SK Hynix will convert the bonds into 129,000 common shares and buy 1,001 more shares in the entity from Bain Capital. The move comes amid strong demand for NAND storage chips used in AI data centers. Counterpoint ranks SK Hynix No. 2 in NAND with a 19% share and Kioxia fourth with 14%.
body.zh: 据路透社（经CNA刊发），SK海力士将把债券转换为12.9万股普通股，并从贝恩资本购入该载体另外1001股。此举正值AI数据中心对NAND存储芯片需求旺盛之际。据Counterpoint，SK海力士NAND份额19%位居第二，铠侠14%位列第四。

title.zh: 李强同新加坡总理黄循财会谈，同意加快自贸协定4.0版谈判
title.en: Li Qiang meets Singapore PM Lawrence Wong, agrees to speed up FTA 4.0 talks

summary.zh: 11月21日上午，国务院总理李强在钓鱼台国宾馆同新加坡总理黄循财会谈，表示愿加快中新自贸协定4.0版谈判，加强人工智能、清洁能源、互联互通、金融等领域合作。
summary.en: Premier Li Qiang held talks with Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong in Beijing on Nov. 21, saying China wants to speed up negotiations on version 4.0 of their free trade agreement and deepen cooperation in AI, clean energy, connectivity and finance.

body.zh: 据新华社，李强还提出推进陆海新通道建设，并在应对人口老龄化、优化公共服务等方面加强交流。他表示中方支持新方明年担任东盟轮值主席国，愿共同落实中国－东盟自贸区3.0版升级议定书。黄循财祝贺中国成功举办深圳APEC会议，表示愿深化人工智能、数字经济、绿色能源等合作。
body.en: According to Xinhua, Li also called for progress on the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor and exchanges on population ageing and public services. He said China supports Singapore's ASEAN chairmanship next year and the China-ASEAN FTA 3.0 upgrade. Wong congratulated China on hosting APEC in Shenzhen and said Singapore wants deeper cooperation in AI, the digital economy and green energy.

sources.name: 中国政府网 / 新华社

title.zh: 发改委开会督促政府投资资金支付，要求加快形成实物工作量
title.en: NDRC urges faster payment of government investment funds

summary.zh: 国家发展改革委召开视频会议，调度政府投资资金支付使用和项目储备工作，要求加快政府投资项目建设和资金支付，形成更多实物工作量，并提高项目前期工作和储备质量。
summary.en: China's top planner held a video conference on spending of government investment funds and project pipelines, calling for faster construction and payments to produce more physical work, and better preparation of future projects.

title.en: Homo erectus teeth show the species lived in Guangxi's rainforests
title.zh: 广西出土直立人牙齿，显示其曾在热带雨林生活

summary.en: A Nature study reports eight Homo erectus teeth from Baxian and Naxian caves in Guangxi, dated to 324,000-184,000 years ago. Evidence suggests they lived in closed-canopy tropical rainforest, extending the species' known survival on mainland Asia.
summary.zh: 《自然》刊发研究，报告在广西八仙洞、那仙洞发现8颗直立人牙齿，年代为距今32.4万至18.4万年。证据显示他们生活在郁闭的热带雨林中，延长了该物种在亚洲大陆的已知存续时间。
